verdict.rationale: Anytype documents first-party controls over where data is retained. Content is stored locally on the device, local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely, users can self-host the sync/backup network, and they can export their data at any time. Nothing in the pack covers actually deleting data, objects or accounts, or setting retention periods. missing for 10: documented deletion of objects/spaces/account, purging of data from backup nodes, retention-period or auto-deletion settings, independent corroboration.
